order_note: No predecessor; SQL 91's public.aws_moov_onboarding_active() and public.aws_moov_webhook_apply_active() are prerequisites (spec prerequisites, with the 24 money tables and roles checksops and authenticated; the file raises sql136_table_missing, sql136_function_missing or sql136_role_missing otherwise). MUST NOT be applied in production before #1498's API is live in production: the eight overlay members (money-write-flag.mjs ADD, then providers/production/moov-wallet-sync.mjs, providers/parity/moov-functions.mjs, tenant-settings-handlers.mjs, tenant-collection-v2-settlement.mjs, tenant-collection-v2.mjs, tenant-billing-engine.mjs, tenant-billing-handlers.mjs, each through its own guarded production overlay run, in plan order) AND a full production Lambda rebuild carrying invoice-provider.mjs, mortgage-ops-usage.mjs and tenant-collection-v2-uat.mjs. Nothing in this tool can check the Lambda; the reviewed change that sets execute true must record the overlay run ids and the rebuild run id that put them live. The applying login must own every money table (altered_relations_owned_by_login: CREATE POLICY needs the owner) and the new function (functions_owned_by_login). The engine's read-only catalog counts must be 0 before any apply: money_tables_forced_rls (money_tables_not_forced_rls; file: sql136_force_rls), money_definer_writers_without_bypass (money_definer_writers_bypass_rls; file: sql136_definer_writer_cannot_bypass_rls) and money_invoker_trigger_writers (no_invoker_trigger_money_writers; file: sql136_invoker_trigger_writes_money_table: the live-only tg_accrue_mortgage_ops_billing, if SECURITY INVOKER, stops it here); money_invoker_function_writers is reported only (a SECURITY INVOKER non-trigger function writing a money table works only when its caller set a flag first; a non-zero count must be reviewed before the apply). Expected production pre-state if no object of the file exists yet: 6b404964de5ee203e126bc3ce78395c9a9e2fbf3a1e41eb0b5ccd8fa3e3ea150 (aws_money_write_allowed() and the 72 policies absent; derived by aws/tests/release-sql136-executor.test.mjs and read back on PostgreSQL 16). Adds no trigger, changes no existing policy, grant, table, column or row.

tooling.note: Guarded tooling for SQL 136: sql136-money-write-restrictive-policies-production-apply.mjs --inspect (read-only) and the receipt-gated --apply on the engine shared with the staging guarded executor (choice sql136-money-write-restrictive-policies); production-sql-one-shot.mjs --migration sql136. intended_replacement_sha256 is the code-derived fingerprint (releaseIntendedHash in release-sql-state.mjs, equal to the staging pin's): public.aws_money_write_allowed() (sql, STABLE, SECURITY INVOKER, EXECUTE authenticated, checksops and the owner) and the 72 RESTRICTIVE policies TO authenticated (INSERT WITH CHECK, UPDATE USING and WITH CHECK, DELETE USING, each public.aws_money_write_allowed()). The tooling does not authorize anything: this pin stays execute false until a reviewed change records the API rollout, the staging acceptance, the production inspect and an owner approval.
